com.altastata.api.accountsetup

Class HPCSUserAccountSetupHandler

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.altastata.api.accountsetup.HPCSUserAccountSetupHandler
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    UserAccountSetupHandlerInterface

    public class HPCSUserAccountSetupHandler
extends java.lang.Object
implements UserAccountSetupHandlerInterface
    HPCS account setup via GREP11 gRPC (no PKCS#11 .so for key generation).

    JavaFX SetupUI calls generateAndSaveKeys(java.lang.String, java.lang.String) when the account name contains hpcs. Requires GREP11_YAML or ALTASTATA_HPCS_YAML pointing to a populated grep11client.yaml. The UI password field is the IAM API key (optional if the YAML already contains one).

    Writes public.key, hpcs-privkey.blob, and hpcs.marker. Sign/decrypt at runtime also use GREP11 when the blob is present.
